title: Ngā Kairangahau Pono Whakaiti
intro: I tētahi whenua o te mana tawhito me te makutu, ka puta he pakanga nui. Kei tētahi taha te mana o ngā tohu atua, ko tētahi taha ia e ngana ana ki te whakataurite i te mea kāore e taea. Mā te mutunga ka huri te huarahi o te hītori ake ake. Ka taea e koe te hura i te tuakiri o te hunga i kite i te pono mutungakore, ā, i whakaiti i a rātou anō ki mua i a ia?
clues: I kite mātou i ngā tohu i tua atu i ngā mahi tinihanga a te makutu
I takoto katoa mātou, kāore i taea te whakakahore i te pono
I mōhio mātou i ahu mai ēnei tohu i te Atua Pono Kotahi
Ko mātou te hapori tuatahi ki te awhi i te whakapono i roto i tēnei huarahi whakamiharo
I whakaaria mai ki a tātou te rangimārie hei utu mō tō tātou whakapono
I rite ā mātou taura me ā mātou tokotoko ki ngā nakahi i mua i ō mātou kanohi, heoi i whiriwhiria e mātou te ngohengohe

Te haerenga a te poropiti i roto i te tohorā
trial.answer: Te tūtakitanga ki te tokotoko a te Poropiti a Mohi

arabic: فَأُلْقِىَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ سُجَّدًۭا قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّ هَـٰرُونَ وَمُوسَىٰ
verse: So the magicians fell down in prostration. They said, "We have believed in the Lord of Aaron and Moses." (20:70)
